F.data_reference: definitional; Faraday constant, as the library's SN modules

V.data_reference: milo2010bionumbers; BNID 103386: E. coli membrane potential -140 to -105 mV, fermenting at the less negative end

E_H.data_reference: Nernst potential at pH 7.6 in, 7.3 out

m_expr.data_reference: definitional; the starting cell has one flagellum (user decision 2026-10-09)

a_motor.data_reference: definitional; motor off until the game runs it

tau_bundle.data_reference: unreferenced_placeholder; time for the flagella to spin up into a bundle when the motors switch on, or to unwind when they stop (E. coli bundles form in a few tenths of a second; Turner, Ryu and Berg 2000, to cite): thrust follows the motor switch with this time constant

a_init.data_reference: definitional; at rest the motors are still

f_ref.data_reference: unreferenced_placeholder; flagellar rotation at the resting proton motive force: ~100 Hz in swimming E. coli (motor speed is proportional to the PMF)

pmf_ref.data_reference: calibrated: the proton motive force of the fermenter at rest (E_H - V)

n_H_rev.data_reference: meister1987proton; about 1,200 H+ per revolution of the E. coli/Streptococcus flagellar motor

v_one.data_reference: unreferenced_placeholder; swimming speed with one flagellum turning at f_flag_ref (E. coli with 4-6 flagella swims 20-30 um/s)

n_half.data_reference: unreferenced_placeholder; flagella at which extra flagella add half as much again: speed saturates with the number (thrust and drag both grow)

eta.data_reference: unreferenced_placeholder; dynamic viscosity of seawater at 20 C and 35 g/kg salinity, about 1.08 mPa s (Sharqawy et al. 2010 tables; to cite)

R_body.data_reference: unreferenced_placeholder; a 2 um cell (typical prokaryote): disc radius
